text:
Maya Chen: FYI getting a couple of customer escalations about elevated p95/p99 on tool-calling routes. Third party app noticed tail latency bumps since ~08:30 UTC.

Devon Patel: see any deploys around that time? deploy-bot: PR 4387 rolled to canary eng-runtime/route-router v2 at 08:22 UTC (50%).

Maya Chen: yep that matches. Symptoms: overall median ~120ms unchanged but p95 doubled (180 -> ~420ms) and p99 from ~600ms -> ~1.8s for requests that include function/tool calling or structured output JSON schemas. Non-tool calls fine.

Sahil Rao: do we have histogram or span traces for the router? I'm guessing the JSON schema validation added sync CPU work per request.

Priya Gomez: grabbing traces now. query: sum by (route) (histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) ) and filter routes with param tool=true.

Priya Gomez: quick snapshot: tool-router v2 routes show p95 430ms / p99 1.84s. route-router v1 (no structured validation) p99 ~620ms.

Devon Patel: stack analyses on canaries show many samples in the router process during ValidateSchema() in the function router. CPU spikes on the router pods.

Maya Chen: reproducible locally by hitting endpoint with function_call + tool schema in payload. Steps:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1", "input":"call tool", "functions":[{"name":"lookup","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}}}}], "function_call":"auto" }'
```
Response latency matches p95/p99 on canary.

Maya Chen: log tail from router pod:
```
2026-03-15T08:26:12Z router-2 INFO incoming request id=abc123 route=tools function_call=true
2026-03-15T08:26:12Z router-2 DEBUG validating schema request_id=abc123 duration=112ms
2026-03-15T08:26:12Z router-2 ERROR validation timeout request_id=abc123 took=1205ms stack=github.com/redwood/validate.(*Schema).Validate
```

Sahil Rao: looks like validation runs synchronously on request path and can hit timeouts. The new validator in v2 uses go-jsonschema with recursive resolution — CPU-heavy for nested schemas. We added strict mode by default in PR 4387.

Devon Patel: correlation: spikes line up with increased percent of requests that include structured outputs (we started enabling structured outputs for a few customers last week). Combined with canary roll -> p99 rises.

Priya Gomez: immediate mitigation options:
- revert canary to v1 (fast but lose improvements)
- patch v2 to short-circuit validation for small/simple schemas or add a validation timeout/async queue
- add request sampling: only validate 1% of structured outputs in prod for now
- increase router pod CPU and concurrency as short-term load soak

Maya Chen: Ops suggestion? Kyle (ops-bot) any capacity headroom?

Kyle (ops-bot): cluster autoscaler triggered + we have free CPU in us-west-2 nodepool; can spin 4 extra router v2 replicas immediately. Note: that masks but doesn't fix blocking behavior.

Devon Patel: I'd prefer adding a runtime flag to bypass strict validation (disable_strict_schema=true) and push an emergency patch to canary pool (or roll forward to non-strict). Lower risk than rollback and keeps other v2 fixes.

Sahil Rao: quick patch idea: change ValidateSchema() to do cheap structural checks inline (shape + types) and offload full JSON Schema Draft-07/2019 validation to background worker that runs post-response. If schema fails later, flag for sampling/alerts but don't block response.

Priya Gomez: timeline:
- 08:40 UTC spin extra router replicas (ops)
- 08:50 UTC push non-strict flag to canary (devon)
- 09:00 UTC monitor p95/p99 for tool routes

Maya Chen: also open a support ticket to affected customers and explain we have a mitigation rolling. add note about potential transient errors.

Devon Patel: created PR 4391: runtime flag disable_strict_schema=true with fallback. Applied to canary (50% -> 10% to reduce blast radius)

Priya Gomez: metrics after change (09:05 UTC): p95 dropped from 430ms -> 210ms, p99 down from 1.84s -> 720ms on canary. Progressing to 100% after monitoring.

Maya Chen: good. Next: root cause follow-up items for postmortem:
- why validation is sync on request path? (design decision in v2)
- add benchmarks for validator with typical customer schemas (deeply nested arrays/objects)
- add heuristic to detect heavy schemas and route through async path automatically
- telemetry: emit validation_duration histogram and schema complexity metric (#keys, nesting_depth)

Priya Gomez: I'll add dashboards/alerts: validation_duration p95>300ms triggers SEV2.

Sahil Rao: engineering follow-ups:
- PR 4402: async validator worker + queue + sampling-based revalidation
- PR 4403: schema lint that flags expensive constructs during model onboarding

Devon Patel: support note draft: "We identified increased tail-latency on requests using function/tool calling caused by synchronous JSON schema validation introduced in a recent router build. We've rolled a mitigation to avoid strict validation on the critical path and are rolling to all traffic. We are working on an async validation and better heuristics. Apologies for the disruption." :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: final ask: owners for follow-ups:
- infra/ops: Kyle (scale + canary rollback path)
- runtime: Devon (patch + PRs)
- validation library: Sahil (benchmarks + async design)

Kyle (ops-bot): noted — I will keep autoscaler and pods in watch.

deploy-bot: rollout status: eng-runtime/route-router v2 -> 100% at 09:22 UTC (flag disable_strict_schema applied).

Maya Chen: please post a short postmortem once PRs land. Closing thread once ticket created.

Priya Gomez: ticket created: INC-2026-079. Adding logs/traces + Grafana links.

Devon Patel: follow-ups assigned, starting on PR 4402 now.

Maya Chen: thanks all — great quick coordination.
